external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The first 300 batteries, bought from a factory Royal Supply still partners with ten years later, sold out in a week. Profits went straight into 500 more. Then 1,000. The goal was gone before the first month was.

The proudest stories are the partners: Pure Plan in Utah, who Royal Supply helped brand before they ever hit a shelf, now one of the top-selling brands in one of the most regulated states in the country. Enlighten in Alaska, five years as their sole packaging provider. Creative Labz, who grew from first customer into a distribution partner bringing their own clients to Royal Supply.
